name: OPDS Books
description: Reads books aloud from e-book catalogs - any OPDS catalog, or a feed of books such as Standard Ebooks' new releases.
examples: read me the book wuthering heights
read me a book from standard ebooks
author: emkay-voice

setup_notes.heading: Install
setup_notes.content:
pip install ovos-skill-opds-books

Like every reading provider, it needs
[ovos-common-reading-pipeline-plugin](https://github.com/andlo/ovos-common-reading-pipeline-plugin) in the intent
pipeline.
